summary:
The plan of w137 is written and covers r70, r80, r71 and r83. The person's answers settle all three earlier questions.
All four scenarios fail at their first Given today: no step writes a proposal with Questions and Answers, Run.items reads work-items only, and workqueue.move refuses approved and formulated.
Decisions:
- r70 applies only to awaiting-answer proposals; a proposal with no questions gets apply with no answers (Q2 A).
- A round is an initiative-round worker through Workers.worker; it 'ends' when it leaves a readable result.
- At the end of a round, work run merges its branch into the initiative branch and deletes it, before the transition (Q1 A).
- A faulted round leaves the proposal's status as it was, and work run exits 1 naming the round and its fault (Q3 B).
- workqueue.move checks statuses by the node's kind; items() does not change.
- New module scripts/supervise_rounds.py, with a CLAUDE.md row. supervise_merge.py and supervise_faults.py join the set.
The decisions break no existing tests.
